approvedBy: User approval of the Applications page
rules: Do not redesign the approved Applications page or its locked shared design-system components.
Keep the two approved application illustrations visibly labeled as illustrative; do not add generated application imagery to fill the page.
Keep real product photographs and the original catalog drawing as the product evidence.
Preserve the page-4 water-drop family scope and the page-6 12 / 14 / 16 Type relationship without extending either to unsupported applications.
Use neutral selection wording such as relevant hinge families, available hinge types, selection support and dimensions for review.
Do not describe a family as the best or definitive choice unless new catalog evidence explicitly establishes that relationship.
Keep the earlier selection-support banner light and compact; keep the final RFQ as the primary dark navy conversion section.
Do not add load, material, tolerance, rating, certification, MOQ, lead-time or other unsupported claims.
